The**minister for equal opportunities**(Italian:*ministro per le pari opportunità*) in[Italy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italy)is one of the positions in the[Italian government](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cabinet_of_Italy).

The current minister is[Eugenia Roccella](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eugenia_Roccella), who is serving in the government of[Giorgia Meloni](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Giorgia_Meloni).
